expectation: The generic multinomial model learns many separate effects for each choice. A smaller shared-utility model may generalize as well or better while giving coherent price responses and simpler explanations. Compare 11 current-only parameters and 13 with history against saved tuned generic and frequency baselines on the same build household folds. History may still offer no reliable gain. Fixed penalty 0.01, no tuning. This is exploratory development after seeing the original check results; do not access check outcomes.

inputs.selection_rule: Select history only if its paired loss difference interval versus utility current-only is entirely below zero. Use the selected utility model for the exploratory demo only if its mean loss is no more than 0.01 worse than tuned generic current-only and its price/explanation checks pass. Otherwise retain tuned generic current-only and report structural-model failure. The 0.01 tolerance is a pragmatic development choice, not a significance threshold.
assumptions: tight budgets may have an extra price penalty

structural_assumptions: A higher own price cannot increase a cleaner’s modeled purchase probability.
Price sensitivity is shared across cleaners; tight budgets may add a penalty.
Only the entrant’s score responds to its message and online channel.
Product utilities are additive; substitution follows multinomial logit assumptions.
These constraints are modeling assumptions, not established causal findings.
